semantic_contract: Fold each sleeve across the torso toward the opposite side of the chest.
Fold the lower body of the garment toward the shoulders, bringing each side of the hem near its corresponding shoulder and aligning the hem edge with the shoulder edge.

The fold is judged at the moment the robot enters the state of both arms back at their reset poses with both grippers open. Everything above must already be true at that moment; if it is not, only a later fresh entry into that state is judged.
If either arm arrives back at its reset pose while the body is folded but a sleeve is not across the chest, the episode ends at once as a permanent failure.
